silhouette.reason: ISO-container box with corner castings, bay ribs, door bars and a glow strip; the long side is still a near-flat plane in the outline.
fixes: deeper bay relief (8–10 cm) or trapezoidal ribs between bays so the long-side outline breaks

proportions.reason: 6.1 × 2.5 × 2.6 m, a 20 ft box; door bars and castings at the right size.
fixes: four hinges per door leaf as on an ISO door photo

materials.reason: Teal paint, steel frame and orange stripe separate and the glow strip is clean. The sawtooth triangle stains are gone from hero.png (soft rust streaks now) and the roof is an even weathered grey instead of triangle camo, but faint triangle tints remain at the panel feet in the sheet SIDE view and the TOP roof mottle is blocky.
fixes: finish moving the weathering off the triangulation: the SIDE view still shows triangle tints along the lower panel edges
roughness variation where hands touch (handles, keypad)

detail.reason: Louvres, door bars, keypad, code text, forklift pockets and a rear vent hatch hold at 3/4.
fixes: door gasket line and customs seal on the right leaf; roof plate fasteners

wear.reason: Rust and grime at the frame base, scraped paint at the corners, a weathered roof, and rust streaks now run below the louvres.
fixes: faded/scraped owner code and chalk or stencil marks on the doors

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 drops the louvres and the weathering: sides go clean teal and the roof flat grey. The softer LOD0 weathering makes the value shift smaller, but the louvres still vanish.
fixes: carry the average weathering tone onto the LOD2 roof and side faces; keep the louvres as dark quads

technical.reason: QA clean; 17k / 7k / 0.7k triangles over 5 draws; the triangle-shaped weathering suggests refinement spent on the bevelled frame rather than plates.
fixes: weather only the side/roof plates on a regular grid to halve refinement cost
